subject: general
question: Which of the following sports is NOT covered in the National Air Sports Policy 2022 of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rally Flying**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Air Sports Policy 2022 (NASP 2022) aims to promote and regulate air sports in India**, encouraging safe and sustainable development of air sports activities.

 
 
• The policy includes a variety of air sports such as:
 
• **Ballooning**: Recreational and competitive flying of hot air balloons.
 
• **Drones**: Unmanned aerial vehicles used for sport, photography, and other applications.
 
• **Paragliding and Hang Gliding**: Gliding activities that involve flying lightweight, free-flying, foot-launched gliders.
 
• **Skydiving**: A sport involving jumping from aircraft and performing aerial maneuvers before deploying a parachute.
 
• **Aeromodelling**: The design and operation of small aircraft models.
 
• **Aerobatics**: Precision flying involving complex maneuvers in aircraft.
 
 
 
• **Rally Flying**, a sport that involves precision navigation and timing with small aircraft, is **not explicitly covered under the National Air Sports Policy 2022**.
 
• The policy primarily focuses on air sports that are more recreational or competitive in nature, involving individual participation or lightweight equipment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Taking another step in the direction of making India one of the top air sports nations by 2030, the Union Ministry of Civil Aviation announced the country’s first 'National Air Sports Policy' in June 2022.
 
• The policy will cover air sports such as aerobatics, aeromodelling, model rocketry, amateur-built and experimental aircraft, ballooning, drones, gliding, and powered gliding, hang-gliding and powered hang-gliding, parachuting (including skydiving, Base jumping, and wingsuit flying), paragliding and paramotoring (including powered parachute trikes), powered aircraft and rotorcraft.
 
• The Air Sports Federation of India (ASFI) will be the apex governing body for this initiative. 
 
• This federation will be chaired by Civil Aviation Ministry Secretary Rajiv Bansal.
 
• The ASFI is an autonomous body and will present India at the Fédération Aéronautique Internationale (FAI) and other global platforms related to air sports.
